# LangChain Build Agent: build and modify LangChain applications

LangChain's official skill for building or modifying LLM applications with Deep Agents, LangGraph, and LangChain. It helps your assistant pick the right piece for each job: Deep Agents for reasoning agents, create_agent for small agents, LangGraph for explicit workflows, or a direct model call when no agent loop is needed. It also explains when LangSmith's Managed Deep Agents fits, and insists on checking the installed package versions and current docs before writing code.
